stateOwnerDisposition: Long-lived Agentd owns one reusable private Browser caller; Browser owns serialized profile/session/page state and a strict persistent operation journal while PooledSubprocessBrowserDriver gives each admitted profile generation its own isolated Servo worker/profile directory. Raw credentials remain external references.
terminalObserverDisposition: Live worker terminality is drained after the final-use admission boundary into the durable Browser owner. Before returning a terminal result the selected Servo worker also fsyncs a host-private inherited-fd receipt bound to profile/generation/operation/page/payload/grant/epoch; post-Browser-crash reconciliation consumes that receipt first. If the worker never terminally observed a remote business effect, a separately trusted business reconciler is still required and genuinely unknowable outcomes remain indeterminate.

operations.sourceSemantics: Admits a profile/principal/generation only after retirement/history fences pass; the long-lived Agentd Browser owner routes it into a bounded subprocess pool, verifies exact worker/Bubblewrap/prlimit artifacts, creates a fresh private principal-bound profile directory and starts one isolated worker generation.

Publishes page-generation-fenced origin plus digest-bound bounded semantic observations from the current-pin Servo WebView; worker admission later revalidates page/document/navigation epoch and a unique visible actionable surface.

tests.command: cd codex-rs && cargo test --locked -p codex-hepta-agentd browser_servo --lib

operations.sourceSemantics: Binds proposal provenance, typed payload, page/document generation, effect grant and live VerifiedUse authority; holds the revocation fence through durable intent fsync and worker admission. The isolated worker has no direct network route: HTTP(S) resources cross the grant-scoped egress broker, which binds operation/profile/effect grant/epoch and validates origin, DNS/IP, redirect and TLS destination. After worker admission the Browser owner drains worker terminality outside the authority fence and persists it; worker-known terminal outcomes are additionally fsynced to a crash-surviving host-private receipt before protocol response. Reserved credential/upload/download schemas remain fail-closed and are not current capabilities.

externalEvidenceGates: terminal-success reproducible current-pin Servo worker artifact/SBOM receipt on the exact candidate
independent Linux target-host namespace/profile/direct-egress-denial/grant-scoped-egress/no-listener/descendant-cleanup qualification and platform equivalents where targeted
real remote-business reconciliation for effects that the old worker did not terminally observe
target resource/soak measurements and independent operator acceptance/activation/promotion/release
credential/upload/download brokers and terminal observers only if those reserved future capabilities are later enabled
